title: Remove the Background Pedestrian
tests: Tests targeted background-person removal with convincing scene reconstruction and no unrelated edits.

judge.summary: The blue-jacketed pedestrian is cleanly removed, with plausible street background and the original scene and framing preserved.

must_haves.item: The pedestrian in the blue jacket on the right is absent.
must_haves.why: The blue-jacketed pedestrian is no longer visible.

must_haves.item: The area formerly occupied by the pedestrian contains plausible, continuous street background without a silhouette or obvious smearing.
must_haves.why: The restored roadway, curb, sidewalk, and background structures appear continuous, with no visible person-shaped residue or obvious smearing.

must_haves.item: The shops, street layout, and sunny lighting remain consistent with the source.
must_haves.why: The shopfronts, road markings, remaining pedestrians, and sunlit appearance are preserved.

must_haves.item: The original wide composition is preserved rather than cropping the person out.
must_haves.why: The output retains the source image's wide framing and scene boundaries.
